verdicts.reason: A and B are almost pixel-for-pixel the same: the original layout is shrunk and centred in the tall canvas. In both, the top title and the date/school lines are tiny, and roughly 130px of empty navy sits above and below the content. Nothing was rearranged to use the taller story format. B sits a few pixels higher and leaves slightly more space under the frame, which is not enough to separate them.
